rubric_items.reason: All ten known requirements, REQ-1 to REQ-10, are traced by S-1 to S-4. The intent has no assumed requirements.
Most stories have one outcome. S-4 bundles two: hiding the section for inactive doctors, and keeping the rest of the page unchanged.

The ACs use Given/When/Then and catch the likely wrong builds: the UTC/IST midnight case, counting past slots as booked, 'Not available' vs free 0. S-1 AC4 states no expected counts, and S-1 AC2/AC4 give no clock.
Most values come from the intent. S-4 AC3/AC4 assert page behaviour that neither input mentions: the 'No availability set.' message, an Inactive warning and a hidden Book appointment button.
The terms match the glossary and the intent, and the prose summary agrees with the frontmatter ACs.

findings.text: S-4 AC3 and AC4 assert existing UI behaviour that is not in the intent or the glossary: the 'No availability set.' message, an Inactive warning, and a hidden Book appointment button. These values are not sourced.

cites.quote: then the 'No availability set.' message and the empty upcoming appointments table are shown as before
the existing Inactive warning and the upcoming appointments are shown as before, and the Book appointment button is still hidden
The rest of the doctor page is `unchanged`

findings.suggested_fix: Cite a source that shows these strings and behaviours exist, or say 'shown exactly as before this change' without naming unsourced UI text.

findings.text: S-1 AC4 gives no other slots for 15 Nov and no expected counts. 'Counts that slot as free' is not something a tester can see directly; only the comparison with the day schedule can be checked.

cites.quote: then the 15 Nov row counts that slot as free, not booked, matching the day schedule for 15 Nov

findings.suggested_fix: List all the 15 Nov slots and state the expected booked and free numbers, as S-1 AC2 does.

findings.text: S-1 AC2 and AC4 use the dates 14 Nov and 15 Nov but give no clock. Whether those dates fall inside the 7-day window depends on the current date, which the Given does not fix.

cites.quote: Given an active doctor whose slots on 14 Nov are 09:00, 09:30 and 10:00 local

findings.suggested_fix: Add a clock to the Given, for example 'the clock is 12 Nov 10:00 local'.

findings.text: S-4 combines two outcomes: no section for inactive doctors (REQ-9), and the rest of the page staying unchanged (REQ-10).

cites.quote: title: Inactive doctors show no section, and the rest of the page is unchanged

findings.suggested_fix: Split S-4 into one story for REQ-9 and one for REQ-10.

cites.quote: One bookable interval of a doctor's slot length, starting at the start of an availability block.
A past slot with a non-cancelled appointment counts as booked; a past slot without one counts as neither.
Each row links to the doctor page with a `?date=` parameter set to that row's date (YYYY-MM-DD).
